messages:
jamie: FYI—on iPhone 12 the bottom action bar (Create + Search) is overlapping the first few table rows when keyboard opens. Repro steps: Console -> Projects -> tap search, type, keyboard pushes up UI and action bar doesn't move. Screenshot attached.

marisa: can repro. Looks like fixed-position bottom bar doesn't respect safe-area inset or keyboard translate. Is this only iOS Safari?

leo: repro on iOS Safari and Android WebView. On narrow widths (<=360px) the bar clips rows even without keyboard sometimes. breakpoint math might be wrong.

sophia: quick accessibility note — when the bar overlaps content, keyboard focus can get trapped. We should ensure focus moves to an input inside viewport and set aria-hidden on background. Also check touch target sizes (>=44px).

design-bot: Suggested pattern: <=360px -> condensed floating FAB; 361-480px -> docked icon-only bar; >480px -> full labeled bar. Also consider using viewport-height threshold to detect keyboard.

jamie: Proposal: switch to floating pattern when viewport-height < 500px or when keyboard is detected. CSS + small JS to apply --keyboard-offset. Example:

```
/* detect keyboard via env(safe-area-inset-bottom) fallback + JS */
.action-bar {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px);
  transform: translateY(var(--keyboard-offset, 0));
}
```

marisa: small copy tweak suggestion: change 'Create' -> 'New project' on mobile to reduce ambiguity. Also, hide secondary labels on small screens.

leo: I'll prototype a compact table density where we collapse non-essential columns to overflow and allow row expand for details rather than forcing horizontal scroll. That should reduce vertical clipping.

sophia: Accessibility: when switching to FAB, ensure role="button" and aria-label present; remove keyboard trap and announce state via a live region: 'Action menu collapsed'. Also check contrast for small icons.

jamie: I'll open a PR bundling a11y updates + breakpoint utility and the CSS changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4721 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued for PR #4721 — devices to test: iPhone 12 (iOS 15), Pixel 4 (Chrome), iPad (landscape). Tests: keyboard interaction, VoiceOver, TalkBack, touch target sizes.

marisa: QA: can someone run VoiceOver & TalkBack? I'll add a checklist to the PR and tag QA. :mag:

leo: I'll test Android WebView and add notes to the PR about WebView keyboard behavior.

sophia: also verifying icon contrast — the condensed icon color drops below 3:1 on certain backgrounds, would prefer a darker neutral.

jamie: action items: leo -> compact table mock + PR; marisa -> update mobile copy + QA checklist; sophia -> a11y ARIA + contrast verification. I'll coordinate follow-up in #devex once PR is up. :thumbsup:

marisa: PR merged to staging :tada: — fix appears to resolve clipping on iOS >=14. Created follow-up for iOS13 fallback (issue #321). Please re-test and file any regressions.
